headline: As of 2026-10-17: 8,464,806 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 39 of 50 states, D+19.7 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 8,464,806 early/mail ballots cast so far across 39 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+19.7 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,175,754), Florida (817,281), Georgia (741,437).
